description: Celebrate 10 days of German beer, bratwurst, and live music at Wurstfest in New Braunfels. Austin Tour Co offers a round-trip BYOB bus experience from Austin with festival admission included.

title: Understated Leather & Allen's Boots Warehouse Sale
description: Understated Leather and Allen's Boots are hosting a massive warehouse sale featuring up to 90% off leather, denim, western wear, cowboy boots, and complimentary Topo Chico Sabores.

title: Witchy Apothecary Pop-Up at Lucille Patio Lounge
description: Lucille Patio Lounge has transformed into a witchy apothecary featuring glowing decor, eerie curiosities, smoking cocktails, and photo ops with no cover charge through November 9.

title: CJ Hendry Flower Shop Pop-Up
description: Australian artist CJ Hendry brings her flower shop pop-up to East Austin, featuring a whimsical wonderland of oversized collectible plush flowers.

title: Seismic Dance Event 9.0
description: Seismic Dance Event 9.0 returns to The Concourse Project from November 13-15 featuring a full lineup of electronic music artists.

title: Austin Mac & Cheese Festival
description: The Austin Mac & Cheese Festival brings cheesy creations from some of Austin's best chefs to Star Hill Ranch, where attendees can taste delicious bites and help crown the champion.

title: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015...
description: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015 This happens to be our 9,000th post (hell ya) From our founder @champagnecates: Our first post ever was SLAB BBQ’s 1 year anniversary with $1 drinks and $1 sandwiches. After 11 years I can honestly say that WWW has the same heart, same ethos, same community-driven mentality from day one. I set out to change the way event-goer and event were connected. I wanted to combine my writing background and my partying background to deliver plans and news in a minimal and personable new way. I feel like we really did all that.
